e: A boat carrying migrants capsizes off the Djiboutian coast, killing 139 passengers.
Interior Minister Omar Abdi Said announces that over 2,500 Yemeni refugees fleeing from the Yemeni civil war arrived in the country.
President Guelleh unveils his new cabinet.
Ismaïl Omar Guelleh is inaugurated for his sixth term as president.
At least nine people die, and 45 go missing, after a migrant boat carrying 320 people is wrecked off the northern coast near Obock.
